name: HealthCare Global Enterprises Ltd
title: HealthCare Global Enterprises Ltd - 539787 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Oncology chain reports FY26 revenue up 15% to INR2,545 crore and adjusted EBITDA margin up 70 bps to 18.5%, but Q4 growth slowed to 11.3% as management deliberately pruned low-margin volume.

utilisation.quote: we have highlighted that a center utilization of 58% today, which reflects future growth potential

capex.quote: average cost is about INR 45 lakh per bed. So that is about INR90-100 crore for 200 beds

triggers.label: Centre utilisation 58%, Ahmedabad ~50%
triggers.quote: in Ahmedabad, for example, at 50% center utilization, there is headroom for growth

triggers.label: 200+ brownfield beds in 24 months
triggers.quote: So that put together should 200+ beds over the next 24 months

triggers.label: Q4 revenue growth slowed to 11.3%
triggers.quote: For Q4 FY26, HCG delivered revenues of INR652 crore, reflecting 11.3% year-on-year growth

triggers.label: Pruning low-margin business, ARPP +3%
triggers.quote: there was a conscious paring down of low-margin business

guidance.quote: in the medium term, our estimate remains close to the 15% growth projections that we had given earlier
we will be adding about 1,000 beds by FY30. 400 of those beds will come through Greenfield expansion and about 600 through the Brownfield expansion

guidance.metric: Internal net debt to EBITDA ceiling
guidance.quote: Internally, we have kept it at 2.5x and I think in the medium to long term, that is where it will be

guidance.value: 20% over next four to five years
guidance.quote: as company we expected to hit a 20% ROCE over next four to five years

guidance.value: about 100 bps further EBITDA margin improvement
guidance.quote: the margin expansion is achievable and we have demonstrated that over the last two quarters

prior_guidance_check.quote: in the medium term, our estimate remains close to the 15% growth projections that we had given earlier
So I am quite confident of delivering on that estimate that we had shared earlier

red_flags.label: Q4 growth 11.3% vs 15% guide; deliberate volume pruning
red_flags.quote: there was a conscious paring down of low-margin business

red_flags.label: Pre-CFO conversion 75% incl. one-off ESOP settlement
red_flags.quote: When you adjust for ESOPs settlement that , the CFO is actually 87%

red_flags.label: Management declined to quantify foregone revenue or centre-level margin buckets
red_flags.quote: Right now we may not be able to answer that question.

evasions.quote: Right now we may not be able to answer that question.
we are for now refraining from giving center -wise details
we are at 58% of our growth potential
I do not want to comment on what was the earlier priority and all
